name: Standing Cross Leg Hamstring Stretch
how_to:
1. Starting Position: Stand tall with both feet together and arms at your sides.
2. Cross Your Legs: Step your right foot over your left so your legs are crossed. Keep both feet flat on the ground and knees slightly bent or straight depending on flexibility.
3. Bend Forward: Slowly hinge at the hips and bend forward, reaching toward your toes or the floor. Let your head hang down and keep your spine relaxed.
4. Hold the Stretch: Grab your ankles, shins, or the floor—wherever your flexibility allows. Hold this position for 20–30 seconds while breathing deeply.
5. Switch Sides: Slowly return to the starting position, then switch your leg cross and repeat the stretch on the other side.
